breakdown.description: It uses a = 4r/√3, but the consistent FCC relation is a = 2√2 r. The stated relation corresponds to BCC geometry, not FCC geometry.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification continues to use the incorrect relation a = 4r/√3 (which is the BCC relation) instead of the correct FCC relation a = 2√2 r. It even proceeds to calculate r using the wrong formula, yielding r ≈ 0.177 nm instead of the correct FCC result of r = a/(2√2) = 0.408/(2√2) ≈ 0.1442 nm. The inconsistency was not fixed at all.
